parsed_json.up: Select exact IC50 activity rows for CHEMBL1865. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records, then to activities, assays, and target_dictionary. Join docs on activities.doc_id and require pubmed_id IS NOT NULL. Inner join compound_structures to enforce presence of canonical_smiles. Return columns compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Keep all rows; do not deduplicate.
